checks.name: Output Format Non-Conformance
checks.definition: An agent emits an output that fails to follow required structural, markup, or formatting specifications at the edge of execution, such as using invalid headers or non-conforming delimiters.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent's output formatting fails specified structural or template constraints, such as malformed section headers or missing required brackets.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output contains ungrounded factual assertions but complies with structural formatting rules, or when the agent emits an entirely wrong payload type.
